page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-standard-384-lssd is a high-density compute instance from the c4d server family. It features 384 dedicated vCPUs built on the x86_64 architecture, paired with 1488.0 GB of system memory. This configuration provides approximately 3.88 GB of RAM per core, establishing a balanced resource ratio suitable for highly parallelized processing tasks.

The instance is equipped with 12,885 GB of local NVMe SSD storage distributed across 32 local SSD drives. This massive local storage capacity delivers high-throughput, low-latency data access directly on the host, which is critical for I/O-intensive operations. No dedicated GPU hardware is included in this configuration, and it does not provide complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the c4d-standard-384-lssd offers a dense consolidation of compute power and local storage on a single physical host. This design reduces the network overhead typically associated with detached block storage, making it highly efficient for large-scale distributed databases, data warehousing, big data analytics, and high-performance computing workloads that require rapid scratch space.
